title: Reasoning-Search-Augmented LLMs: An Operational Taxonomy, Benchmark Analysis and Controlled Evidence Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.29189v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive emergent reasoning capabilities, yet they remain constrained by fixed model parameters and finite context windows. Even when augmented with static retrieval, they can produce statements that are unsupported by, or even contradictory to, retrieved evidence. This leads to hallucinations, difficulty incorporating up-to-date information, and failures to correctly interpret or reconcile sources. Recent work addresses these limitations by tightly coupling step-by-step reasoning with interactive search, treating retrieval as an action within an iterative agentic loop rather than a one-shot preprocessing step. This study reviews frameworks that implement such reasoning-search loops by interleaving planning, querying, retrieval, integration, verification, and stopping. We analyze these systems through four architectural axes: retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and groundi

translated_title: 推理-搜索增强的大语言模型：一种操作分类体系、基准分析与受控证据综合
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现出令人印象深刻的涌现推理能力，但它们仍受限于固定的模型参数和有限的上下文窗口。即使通过静态检索进行增强，它们也可能产生不受检索证据支持、甚至与检索证据相矛盾的陈述。这导致了幻觉问题、难以融入最新信息，以及无法正确解读或协调不同信息来源的失败。近期的工作通过将逐步推理与交互式搜索紧密耦合来解决这些局限性，将检索视为迭代式智能体循环中的一个动作，而非一次性的预处理步骤。本研究回顾了通过交错执行规划、查询、检索、整合、验证和停止等环节来实现此类推理-搜索循环的框架。我们通过四个架构维度对这些系统进行分析：检索耦合方式、控制器设计、知识来源与接地机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对推理-搜索增强大语言模型（LLMs）的操作性分类体系，通过检索耦合、控制器设计、知识来源和接地机制四个架构维度系统性地分析将逐步推理与交互式搜索紧密耦合的框架，并提供了基准分析与受控证据综合。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an operational taxonomy of reasoning-search-augmented LLMs, systematically analyzing frameworks that tightly couple step-by-step reasoning with interactive search across four architectural axes—retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and grounding—along with benchmark analysis and controlled evidence synthesis.
